description: The provider that delivers this account's traffic; an account whose provider has no registered send adapter is never routed to.
label: Provider
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_provider

label: Provider Credentials (outbound — the CRM calls the provider)
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_section_credentials

description: The tenant's WABA number in digits, with the country code and no '+' (e.g. 919558240583); shown as the outbound 'From' number.
label: Channel Number (WATI)
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_wati_channel_number

description: Created by the 'Generate Webhook Token' button above: click it, save, then use 'Copy Webhook URL' and register that URL with the provider. It proves the caller is the provider and tells the CRM which account the message arrived on. Blank means inbound is off.
label: Webhook Token
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_token

description: The provider's webhook carries a URL, and the CRM downloads the image or document a patient sent from it. Listing the provider's media hosts here means the CRM downloads from those hosts only, so a forged webhook cannot point the server at a URL of the attacker's choosing. Blank allows any public host (private and internal addresses are always blocked).
label: Media Host Allowlist (SSRF)
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_media_host_allowlist

description: This agent's Acefone agent/follow-me number (digits). Used to map inbound calls to the Frappe user and as the bridge leg for click-to-call.
label: Acefone Number
name: CRM Telephony Agent-acefone_number

label: Other Products
name: CRM Lead-custom_patient_other_programs
options: ("; ".join(sorted({(r.custom_vertical or "?") + " / " + (r.custom_current_program or "?") for r in frappe.get_all("CRM Lead", filters={"mobile_no": doc.mobile_no, "name": ["!=", doc.name or ""]}, fields=["custom_vertical","custom_current_program"], ignore_permissions=True)}))) if doc.mobile_no else ""

label: Computed BMI
name: CRM Lead-custom_computed_bmi
options: frappe.utils.flt(doc.custom_weight_kg) / (frappe.utils.flt(doc.custom_height_feet) * 0.3048 * frappe.utils.flt(doc.custom_height_feet) * 0.3048) if (frappe.utils.flt(doc.custom_height_feet) and frappe.utils.flt(doc.custom_weight_kg)) else None

description: Derived, never entered. A Password field cannot be indexed, so this digest is what makes authentication one read rather than a scan and decrypt of every account.
label: Token Digest
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_token_hash

description: The token is always enforced; HMAC is added only for a provider that signs its payloads, which WATI does not.
label: Authentication
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_auth_mode

description: The header carrying the provider's signature, e.g. X-Signature.
label: Signature Header
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_hmac_header

description: Stripped before comparison, e.g. 'sha256='. Left blank when the provider sends a bare signature.
label: Signature Prefix
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_hmac_prefix

description: Rejects any inbound call that does not come from an address listed below. Leave it off unless the provider publishes fixed addresses — a wrong list silently drops every message. It cannot be turned on while the list is empty.
label: Enforce IP Allowlist
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_enforce_ip

description: One IP address or CIDR range per line, e.g. 13.234.10.5 or 13.234.0.0/16. Anything after a # is ignored. Read only when Enforce IP Allowlist is ticked.
label: Allowed Addresses
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_ip_allowlist
